blocks.text: In the early 20th century, the Darwinism was integrated with modern genetics to develop Neo-Darwinism. According to Neo-Darwinism, a more precise definition of evolution is “a change in the frequency of alleles in a population or in the total genetic makeup of a population (the gene pool)”. Neo-Darwinism is based on Hardy-Weinberg Theorem.
